author: Myv
body:
Hey there. I've noticed that a select few of the forum posts on any categories of it have stars next to them, which I presume means that they are special posts that have been decided for by Moderators. My Guess The AvicusER post has nearly 10000 views, so I don't know if that means I could get a star on it.

I just wanted to know this - how do you get the star next to your forum post?

Thanks

replies.body:
A thread gets sticked if a moderator think it's important to the forums.

Personally I'm not sure if you're thread will get sticked.
Yes, it is popular.
But it is that important to the forums that it needs to be highlighted?
Probably not.
